Hi Marissa/Laura,

Draft answers below (I'll convert to their spreadsheet and attach a short writeup). High-level summary first, then terse answers to each RFI row. Feel free to edit.

High-level summary:
- Hosted API: Redwood operates in major cloud regions across US, EU and APAC. Primary available regions today: us-east-1 (Ashburn), us-west-2 (Oregon), eu-central-1 (Frankfurt), eu-west-1 (Ireland), ap-southeast-1 (Singapore), ap-southeast-2 (Sydney). Customers can select the region for hosted endpoints at provisioning time; we do not replicate customer inference data across regions unless configured for multi-region redundancy.
- Regional guarantees: For hosted endpoints you can pin a model endpoint to a single region. Data at-rest (request payloads, KV cache, embeddings, short-lived logs) remain in that region. Long-term analytics/aggregated traces can be configured to respect region retention or exported to customer-controlled sinks only.
- KMS/HSM: We support customer-managed keys (CMKs) via cloud KMS in supported regions (e.g., AWS KMS in the same region). HSM-backed key storage is available for Dedicated and Private options where required. Note: if you select a cloud KMS key in eu-central-1, keys remain in that region as enforced by the cloud provider.
- Private deployment: Private (VPC) deployments keep all inference runtime and storage within your VPC and region. The control plane can be configured to use a customer-managed control plane in-region; alternatively, we offer an air-gapped package for on-prem that does not phone home. Telemetry/heartbeat data by default is kept to a minimum and can be disabled; any optional telemetry that is enabled can be routed to customer endpoints only.
- Compliance: We can provide a SOC 2 Type II summary and data residency annex. Full reports available under NDA.

Detailed RFI rows (short):
1) Regions (hosted inference): us-east-1 (US-East / Ashburn), us-west-2 (US-West / Oregon), eu-central-1 (EU Central / Frankfurt), eu-west-1 (EU West / Ireland), ap-southeast-1 (APAC / Singapore), ap-southeast-2 (APAC / Sydney).
2) Data residency options: Endpoint-level region pinning available; no cross-region replication unless explicitly enabled.
3) Data categories: Input payloads, outputs, KV cache, embeddings, short-lived logs stored in-region. Aggregates/usage metrics can be restricted per contract.
4) KMS support: Customer-managed KMS supported in-region. HSM-backed keys for Dedicated/Private.
5) Private/on-prem: Available; control-plane behavior customizable (in-region control plane or air-gapped).
6) Telemetry: Configurable; default minimal telemetry. Can deliver logs to customer S3/GCS/Azure Blob in chosen region.

I'll attach: Redwood_RFI_answers_20260222.pdf (draft) and a SOC2 summary extract. Comments welcome.
